findings.title: Net Revenue Change: Analysis Period vs Previous Week
findings.claim: Net revenue in the analysis period (2026-05-18 to 2026-05-25) was SAR 50672.40, compared to SAR 45136.20 in the previous period (2026-05-11 to 2026-05-18), representing a change of SAR 5536.20 (12.27%).
coverage_notes: Refund rows are included in line_total_sar calculation
assumptions: Valid transactions are counted using unique transaction_id values
Refund rows (is_refund=True) are included in net revenue calculations
line_total_sar represents realized net revenue per line item
Timestamp filtering uses UTC+3 timezone as provided

findings.title: Valid Transaction Count Change: Analysis Period vs Previous Week
findings.claim: Valid transaction count in the analysis period (2026-05-18 to 2026-05-25) was 1434, compared to 1313 in the previous period (2026-05-11 to 2026-05-18), representing a change of 121 transactions (9.22%).
assumptions: Valid transactions are counted using unique transaction_id values where is_refund=False
Refund rows are excluded from transaction count
Timestamp filtering uses UTC+3 timezone as provided

findings.title: Average Order Value Change: Analysis Period vs Previous Week
findings.claim: Average Order Value (AOV) in the analysis period (2026-05-18 to 2026-05-25) was SAR 35.34, compared to SAR 34.38 in the previous period (2026-05-11 to 2026-05-18), representing a change of SAR 0.96 (2.79%). AOV is calculated as net revenue (including refunds) divided by valid transaction count (excluding refund rows).
coverage_notes: Valid transactions exclude refund rows from denominator
AOV calculation: net revenue / valid transaction count
assumptions: Valid transactions are counted using unique transaction_id values where is_refund=False
Net revenue includes refund rows (they are negative values in line_total_sar)
AOV is intentionally calculated as net revenue (including refunds) divided by valid transaction count (excluding refund rows) to reflect the average value per customer transaction
Timestamp filtering uses UTC+3 timezone as provided
